would_have_shipped_defects.summary: No new drill cases were added anywhere: the only change to the in-scope hermetic drill is a four-line comment, so DoD (d), (e) and (g) ship as unverified behaviour.
would_have_shipped_defects.why_blocking: The order's DoD is "drill green including the new cases", and its whole thesis (retro 2 D6) is that a repair holds only where it becomes code or a checked moment. The operator merging this PR gets the new coverage strings, the --review vocabulary and the refuse-not-rebase change with nothing asserting them, so the next edit to hive-score's coverage case, its --review validation, or commit_metrics' push path regresses silently — exactly the D1 failure mode this order exists to close. The candidate's own report cites the 101 green cases as the verification of this work, but none of the 101 touch any behaviour it added.

would_have_shipped_defects.evidence: artefacts/workspace.patch:76-78 ("The metrics drill received the bounded hygiene fold: EXIT cleanup is installed before scratch isolation, and its log assertion avoids `grep -q` SIGPIPE under `pipefail`") against candidate.patch:104-111, whose whole hive-metrics-drill.sh change is the added comment block; no file list, no instance count, and no "none found" statement appears anywhere in the report.
would_have_shipped_defects.summary: The drill-hygiene sweep is not reported in the form DoD (h) requires, and the result report asserts a fold that the diff does not contain.
would_have_shipped_defects.why_blocking: DoD (h) asks for files read, instances of the two classes found, and fixes made — or "none found", stated. The report instead says the drill "received the bounded hygiene fold", which reads to the reviewing operator as "instances were found and fixed"; the diff makes no code change to trap ordering and no change to any `grep -q`, only a comment. The operator therefore cannot tell whether hive-metrics-drill.sh was clean of both classes or whether findings were left unfixed, which is the one thing this bounded fold was supposed to establish.
